description: Prepare the kitchen and living room for a family movie night. Identify and prepare snacks and drinks using ingredients you can observe in the kitchen, then arrange the living room seating and lighting for a viewing experience.
I’m not feeling well today and staying home. Prepare light food and warm drinks in the kitchen using visible items, and bring them to the bedroom to set up for my comfortable rest.

Prepare the house for a full day of working from home. Set up a comfortable workspace in the living room and bring simple food and drinks from the kitchen to the living room workspace for easy access.
A guest is arriving in 30 minutes for a pajama party in the bedroom. Quickly tidy the kitchen and bedroom, prepare simple snacks, and set up the bedroom as the main space for guests to relax and eat.
A video call meeting is starting in 20 minutes. Set up a comfortable workspace in the bedroom, and prepare a drink from the kitchen to bring to the bedroom to stay focused during the call.
Prepare the home for an indoor workout session. Clear sufficient open space in the living room for exercise, and prepare a snack tray from the kitchen to keep energy up.
Prepare the home for a long-term vacation. Collect any remaining food items from the kitchen and bring them to the bedroom so I can pack them before leaving.
Unexpected guests are coming in 15 minutes. Quickly prepare a snack tray in the kitchen using visible items and tidy the living room for hosting.
The baby needs to leave for daycare in 30 minutes. Prepare a simple meal in the kitchen using visible items, and organize the bathroom with towels and hygiene items to wash the baby.
The baby urinated on the bed. Bring the bedding to the bathroom for washing, then prepare clean towels in the bathroom to clean the baby.
